scope: Primary-source input research only. No plant contact, live control, new forecast or scheduler implementation; no actual Paphos plant capacity or permission established.

sources.title: Curtailment Procedure for Photovoltaic (PV) Generation — Information for Consumers & Producers
sources.authority: Electricity Authority of Cyprus, Distribution System Operator
sources.date_evidence: No printed publication/revision date found. PDF creation/modification metadata: 2025-12-04 11:13:06 EET; HTTP Last-Modified is retrieval metadata, not proof of publication date.
sources.method: Full text extraction and visual inspection of all three pages.
supports: Curtailment stages depend on network conditions and installation classification/connection terms.
Some earlier zero-export stages retain self-consumption; the emergency fourth stage stops all PV production, including zero-export installations.
TSOC makes final curtailment coordination/decisions using real-time conditions; stages can change dynamically.
limits: Simplified general process, not a particular asset’s connection agreement, valid load authorization, plant power allocation or live dispatch signal.
Irradiance and public curtailment reports do not by themselves establish usable otherwise-curtailed electricity at a desalination asset.

sources.title: FilmTec Reverse Osmosis/Nanofiltration Membranes Technical Manual
sources.method: Current official PDF downloaded; operation text extracted; revision/footer and relevant startup/shutdown pages visually inspected.
supports: Minimize frequent starts/stops and increase pressure smoothly; operating conditions and protection limits matter.
Startup/shutdown can consume flush water, discard permeate and require preservation and conductivity checks.
Production adjustment depends on actual design and feed composition/temperature.
limits: Generic FilmTec guidance; the actual Paphos train and membrane identity are unknown. It is not an approved site SOP, potable-water release standard or brine-discharge permit.
Initial startup examples are not a site-approved minimum run time or routine ramp/flush duration. No numeric plant constraints are imported from these examples.

supporting_existing_operator_record.observed: Group 1 non-priority curtailment window 10:00–14:15; TSOC instruction marked yes, reason low loading. The main report energy fields are estimated day energy 2691.5 MWh and estimated curtailed energy 331.7 MWh. These are not plant allocations or a claim that all day energy was curtailed.
supporting_existing_operator_record.limits: Retrospective estimated report fields, not site allocations, measured recoverable power, national totals or dispatch permission. The printed times lack explicit UTC offsets.

main_report_energy_fields.field_scope: Main report fields retained separately from Ripple/IoT estimates; Group 1 identifies the reported window, not a proven energy allocation to that group or a desalination site.

excluded_capacity_evidence.observed: Search index displayed a 2026-02-03 page date alongside Paphos construction-in-progress text expecting completion by the end of 2019.
excluded_capacity_evidence.retrieval_limit: Direct request returned HTTP 403; no live page body was obtained.
excluded_capacity_evidence.decision: Do not treat the indexed nominal capacity or construction text as current plant operation, spare capacity or installed train proof.

proposed_contract.unknown_handling: Missing, delayed, expired or unauthenticated inputs remain unknown. Do not replace them with zero, forecasts labeled as telemetry or permission inferred from weather.
